meta.title: Order a parcel | Billy Belly Chicken

parcel.title: Parcel, please
parcel.lead: Pick your dishes, tell us your name and number, and collect with your token.
parcel.how: No payment here. A waiter confirms your order with you, tells the chef, and you pay at the counter when you collect.
parcel.name: Your name
parcel.tokenHint: Show this token at the counter
parcel.readyMsg: Your parcel is ready. Please collect it at the counter.
parcel.handedMsg: Enjoy your meal. Thank you for choosing Billy Belly.
parcel.closedText: The kitchen is not taking orders right now. Please speak to the staff.
